description: This file contains service functions for managing trainers, their availability, and bookings in a gym management system, including create, update, delete, list, and booking operations.

methods.name: create_trainer
methods.description: Creates a new trainer record in the database with provided name and bio.

methods.name: update_trainer
methods.description: Updates an existing trainer record identified by trainer_id with provided fields.

methods.name: delete_trainer
methods.description: Deletes a trainer record identified by trainer_id.

methods.name: list_trainers
methods.description: Returns a list of all trainers.

methods.name: add_availability
methods.description: Adds an availability time slot for a trainer, ensuring end_time is after start_time.

methods.name: list_availability
methods.description: Lists all availability slots for a specific trainer, ordered by start_time.

methods.name: create_trainer_booking
methods.description: Creates a booking for a trainer, ensuring it falls within availability and does not overlap with existing bookings.

methods.name: cancel_trainer_booking
methods.description: Cancels a booking, only if the user is the owner or an admin.
